WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    "ordersmark",
    AVG("remaincount") AS avg_unfilled_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM "orderexecutions"
  WHERE "expirespot" >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND "expirespot" <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY "ordersmark"
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unfilled_quantity) AS average_of_order_averages,
  SUM(execution_count) AS total_execution_count
FROM per_order;

assumptions.assumption: The expiry values are compared as text, as requested, using the column’s stored text representation; the endpoints are inclusive.
